## Change

Tell what this pull request changes and why.

## Requirements and criteria

List the requirement IDs (FR-..., NFR-...) and the acceptance criteria IDs (AC-...) that this change covers.

## Checklist

- [ ] All commits have a `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] New tests refer to their acceptance criteria IDs.
- [ ] The change does not put secrets in logs or process arguments.
- [ ] If the change alters an accepted decision, a new ADR is included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated and Vale shows no errors.
